interactions.note: The epitope-specific CSL311 mAb inhibited the proliferation of TF-1 cells in response to the βc-signaling cytokines, IL-3, GM-CSF and IL-5. CSL311 was significantly more potent than both parental antibodies 9A2 and 9A2-VR24 at inhibiting the proliferation of TF-1 cells in response to all  three cytokines. MAb CSL311 completely blocked the survival of eosinophils in the presence of the cocktail of IL-5, GM-CSF and IL-3, in a dose-dependent manner. CSL311 also caused a significant decrease in survival in vitro of sputum eosinophils obtained from 5 of 8 asthmatic subjects.

interactions.note: The epitope-specific CSL311 Fab bound to soluble βc with a 4.6-fold greater affinity than 9A2-VR24 due to a further 2.6-fold improvement in dissociation rate (kd). Single amino acid substitutions Y39A, F103A, I338A, Q339A, Y365A, H367A, I368A and I424A in ßc significantly reduced binding of CSL311 Fab. Q339 and I424 do not make any interactions with CSL311, in contrast they are buried deep in the D1-D4 interface of the βc dimer, therefore the loss of binding of CSL311 observed for these mutants may be due to a structural effect on the βc dimer.

interactions.assay: radio immuno assay (RIA) · dissociation constant KD
interactions.note: The epitope-specific [125]I-labeled CSL311 mAb bound to βc-expressing cells, neutrophils, eosinphils and TF-1 cells, with comparable binding affinity, in the range of KD = 250–730 pM with an average KD= 426 ±79 pM. Human neutrophils and eosinophils are potently activated by the βc family of cytokines with neutrophils expressing only GM-CSF receptors and eosinophils expressing receptors for GM-CSF, IL-3 and IL-5. The human cell line TF-1 expresses receptors for GM-CSF, IL-3 and IL-5. A recombinant Fab fragment of CSL311 bound with similar or slightly higher affinity than the intact CSL311, KD = 380–670 pM, suggesting that the IgG form of CSL311 binds monovalently to cells expressing βc.
